categories.crash: A broad, fast fall in prices
categories.rally: A broad, fast rise in prices
categories.bubble_top: The sharp end of a long run-up
categories.flash_crash: A fall that mostly reversed within days
categories.short_squeeze: A rise forced by traders closing bets against the asset
categories.depeg: A stablecoin or pegged asset losing its peg
categories.exchange_failure: A hack or the failure of an exchange or lender
categories.rate_shock: A surprise in interest rates or central bank policy
categories.currency_shock: A sharp move in a currency from politics or capital flows
categories.supply_shock: A sudden change in supply, such as oil or mining
categories.geopolitical: War, sanctions or a major political event
